description: Estate score: the public STANDING number built from what a wallet holds in the Upper City (apartment by level L2 10, L3 30, L4 100, L5 400; vehicle Courier 10, Sentinel 30, Hauler 60, Helicopter 150, Private jet 300; an Override Disk 100, counted once), plus the Estate leaderboard. Tiers by score: Resident 10, Owner 50, Holder 150, Magnate 400 (proposed). Pass a wallet for its score, tier, parts, rank and what it unlocks (trusted jobs need Owner 50; a Velvet Circuit seat needs a Disk and Holder 150; a High Table seat needs a Disk and Magnate 400; these are Worker/site checks, not on chain). It pays nothing and promises no income: it only ranks wallets, next to Rep. Read only.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: get_estate
